offers_services.reason: Matting rental, installation, site planning, logistics and remediation services are core; rental fleet is the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are utilities, pipeline, energy and construction project owners, not households.

cyclical_demand.reason: Demand depends on energy, utility and construction project spending, which can be deferred in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Mostly project rentals and services rather than large infrequent purchases, though mat sales can be sizable.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from the composite mat fleet and manufactured product, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large utilities, pipeline and energy companies, and major contractors.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns a large rental fleet of composite mats plus manufacturing operations needing ongoing capital investment.

notes: Mix of rental, sales and services; the rental/service share is judged larger from the website text.
